# eth_rpc_module

> Proxyable, fail-closed Ethereum JSON-RPC client. Per-chain config (endpoint + proxy); RPC calls keyed by chainId. socks5h/Tor-ready.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `set_chain_config` | `set_chain_config(chain_id: int, config_json: tstr) -> bool` | Store config for a chain. |
| `get_chain_config` | `get_chain_config(chain_id: int) -> tstr` |  |
| `remove_chain_config` | `remove_chain_config(chain_id: int) -> bool` |  |
| `list_chains` | `list_chains() -> tstr` | `{ ok, chains: [chainId, ...] }`. |
| `list_chain_configs` | `list_chain_configs() -> tstr` | The chain registry, including metadata, enabled state and device-wide scope. |
| `set_chain_enabled` | `set_chain_enabled(chain_id: int, enabled: bool) -> tstr` |  |
| `patch_chain_metadata` | `patch_chain_metadata(chain_id: int, metadata_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Patch name/nativeSymbol/nativeDecimals/testnet. |
| `get_network_scope` | `get_network_scope() -> tstr` |  |
| `set_network_scope` | `set_network_scope(scope: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `verify_chain_id` | `verify_chain_id(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | `eth_chainId` round-trip → `{ ok, chainId }`. |
| `block_number` | `block_number(chain_id: int) -> tstr` |  |
| `get_balance` | `get_balance(chain_id: int, address: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `call` | `call(chain_id: int, call_json: tstr, deadline_ms: ? int) -> tstr` | `eth_call` — `call_json` is a `{ to, data }` object (ERC20 reads). |
| `get_transaction_count` | `get_transaction_count(chain_id: int, address: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `gas_price` | `gas_price(chain_id: int) -> tstr` |  |
| `fee_history` | `fee_history(chain_id: int, blocks: int, reward_percentiles_json: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `estimate_gas` | `estimate_gas(chain_id: int, tx_json: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `send_raw_transaction` | `send_raw_transaction(chain_id: int, raw_hex: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `get_transaction_receipt` | `get_transaction_receipt(chain_id: int, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `get_transaction_by_hash` | `get_transaction_by_hash(chain_id: int, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `raw_rpc` | `raw_rpc(chain_id: int, method: tstr, params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Escape hatch for any standard JSON-RPC method. |
| `raw_rpc_url` | `raw_rpc_url(chain_id: int, url: tstr, method: tstr, params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Like [`Self::raw_rpc`] but POSTs to an explicit `url` (not the chain's configured endpoint), reusing `chain_id`'s fail-closed proxied client. |
| `ensure_chain_config` | `ensure_chain_config(chain_id: int, config_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Seed a chain only where it is ABSENT, per field, returning which fields were written. |
| `patch_chain_transport` | `patch_chain_transport(chain_id: int, timeout_secs: int, verified_timeout_secs: int) -> tstr` | Overwrite only the transport timeouts this module owns. |
| `patch_chain_endpoint` | `patch_chain_endpoint(chain_id: int, endpoint: tstr) -> tstr` | Overwrite ONLY the endpoint, creating the chain with defaults if it is absent. |
| `set_verified_proxy_mode` | `set_verified_proxy_mode(chain_id: int, mode: tstr) -> tstr` | `"off"` talks to the endpoint; `"required"` routes through the light-client proxy and REFUSES rather than falling back. |
| `verified_proxy_status` | `verified_proxy_status(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | The verified-proxy verdict for one chain: what state it is in, whether a verified call would answer now, and what the user has to do about it. |
| `config_status` | `config_status() -> tstr` | Whether a config has been SET, and what it is — no network I/O, no call to another module, so it is cheap enough for a consumer's startup path. |
| `init_defaults` | `init_defaults() -> tstr` | Seed the built-in chains, per chain and per FIELD, only where absent. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `chain_config_changed` | `chain_config_changed(chain_id: int)` | One chain's stored record was added, removed, or altered. |
| `chain_enabled_changed` | `chain_enabled_changed(chain_id: int, enabled: bool)` |  |
| `network_scope_changed` | `network_scope_changed(scope: tstr)` |  |
| `verified_proxy_mode_changed` | `verified_proxy_mode_changed(chain_id: int, mode: tstr)` | The verified-proxy gate for one chain moved. |
